Weak short-term liquidity (current ratio 0.63) and a very liability-heavy balance sheet (liabilities are about 73% of assets, roughly 2.7x equity) weigh on credit quality. Still, the issuer has a large absolute equity base, positive retained earnings, and positive operating income, supporting a low-end investment-grade assessment rather than a clearly speculative one.

DECISION: BBB-
